items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Gordy Bourns says, “When I wear the hat I can’t play the tuba, the tuba hits it.”

ctx.x: I’ve always insisted that the straw hats be worn. And it’s been, I think a boon to us because our publicity is very good. The pictures of us in the Alumni Review for example with the hats on are terrific, it’s a uniform thing. But lately I’m getting a lot of resistance to wearing the hats. And two sources. Gordy Bourns says, “When I wear the hat I can’t play the tuba, the tuba hits it.” And Phil Mead, his trombone slide hits the hat. And that is absolutely right, those are justifiable complaints.
